1062-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-complete.text:
Bravely done, $N.

We may ultimately need the wisdom of $r elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...

Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
1062-complete.title: Goblin Invaders

1063-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1063-accept.text:
To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the $r elders.

I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha.  I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much.  If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the $r, it is she.

Magatha resides in the $r capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff.  Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
1063-accept.title: The Elder Crone

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1094-complete.name: Sputtervalve
1094-complete.text:
Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.

They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
1094-complete.title: Further Instructions

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

2-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-complete.text:
Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get!  The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post.  No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
2-complete.title: Sharptalon's Claw

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

23-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
23-complete.text:
Ah, the paw of Ursangous!  Your skill is impressive, $c; he is credited with numerous kills.  The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale.  Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts.  To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.

Your ancestors would be proud!
23-complete.title: Ursangous's Paw

23-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
23-progress.text: Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you!  How goes your hunting?
23-progress.title: Ursangous's Paw

24-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-complete.text:
A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt!  Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.

Shadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here.  Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger.  Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
24-complete.title: Shadumbra's Head

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

247-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
247-complete.text:
$N, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt.  You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity.  The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!

Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today.  May your ancestors watch over you!
247-complete.title: The Hunt Completed

25-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-accept.text:
If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?
25-accept.title: Stonetalon Standstill

6503-complete.name: Kuray'bin
6503-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  Your hunting skills are impressive...

The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
6503-complete.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6544-complete.name: Ertog Ragetusk
6544-complete.text:
So Torek's attack was successful!  Well done, $N.  Night elves are decent foes.  A little skinny, but strong and fierce!  I'm sure the battle was something to see...

And I hope you gained a scar or two!
6544-complete.title: Torek's Assault

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies
